name: Curator indexed → Researcher (re-query augmented corpus)
description: ADR-040 rule. When the source-curator terminates with decide(action=indexed), spawn a fresh researcher to re-query the augmented corpus. The new researcher reads the curator's emit_curator_artifact output via read_loop_result on $entity.instance — the artifact lists verified_entity_ids and (when present) source_dirs the researcher can build on without re-doing the curator's discovery work. Recovery is supersession-via-new-spawn (Shape A): the new researcher is the research-artifact author for this chain. The next 01a firing on the new researcher's completion re-stamps lineage.researcher to its loop_id, preserving the architect-reachability invariant.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.researcher
on_enter.prompt:
Re-research pass — the source-curator at loop $entity.instance added one or more sources, waited for indexing, and verified entity IDs resolve. Read the curator's emit_curator_artifact output via read_loop_result on $entity.instance — the artifact lists verified_entity_ids you can query directly (the curator already confirmed they resolve) and may include source_dirs for bash-cat fallback when graph queries don't cover the case (build configs like build.gradle, package.json, etc.).

Query the augmented corpus to address the original research question. Build on the curator's verified IDs — don't re-validate them. When ready, call emit_research_artifact with the full structured artifact, then emit a completion message containing the same artifact JSON for the reviewer to read. Populate addressed_gaps with what you covered (cite the curator's added sources); populate open_gaps with anything you still cannot resolve.

metadata.phase_4_dependency: Stamper supersession (chain entity's chain.research_artifact.loop reference) is Phase 4 of ADR-039 — until it lands, the chain entity's milestone references won't update on the new researcher's artifact. The supersession is real in the graph (new researcher loop entity, new artifact triples) but the chain.* pointer stays stale.
metadata.max_iterations_note: Mirrors ADR-039 rule 08 — outer max_iterations=3 is informational under the current rule engine since coordinator.next_action is single-state. The spawned researcher's inner max_iterations=3 is the actionable bound on a single re-query pass.
metadata.lineage_forwarding: related_loops.researcher is intentionally NOT forwarded — the new researcher IS the research-artifact author for this chain (supersession-via-new-spawn). Forwarding from the curator's lineage would point at the SUPERSEDED original researcher, violating the architect-reachability invariant. The next 01a firing on the new researcher's completion re-stamps lineage.researcher = $entity.instance of the recovery researcher; downstream architect/reviewer/etc. see the new artifact pointer. Same supersession pattern as ADR-039 rule 08 (architect needs_clarification → researcher).
metadata.model_choice: research model — re-query of the augmented corpus is the same task shape as initial research. The curator already absorbed the substrate-decision cost (architecture model).
